description: Address review feedback: remove dead expected_outputs mutation in voice stage, fix substring folder matching in produce.py, add clarifying comment to render stage empty expected_outputs.
steps: Remove the dead `self.expected_outputs = ["voice/voiceover.mp3"]` line in pipeline/stages/voice.py since the custom validate_output() handles both extensions already.
In produce.py, fix find_video_folder to strip the numeric prefix and compare the full slug exactly instead of using substring containment.
In pipeline/stages/render.py, add a comment to the empty expected_outputs explaining why it is empty (rendered output paths are dynamic, validated by custom override).
Run pytest tests/ -v and verify all tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: voice.py no longer mutates self.expected_outputs at runtime
find_video_folder uses exact slug matching after stripping numeric prefix
render.py has a clarifying comment on expected_outputs = []
findings: All three review issues fixed cleanly. No test changes needed since existing tests cover the affected code paths. 60 tests still pass.
